training_scope: 275,810 rows in frozen train_structs.parquet, rather than all raw spectrum-level SMILES aliases. Stereo removal and tautomer choice preserve elemental composition. Fragment catalogue membership uses exact RDKit IK14, not all-tier scorer tautomer equivalence.
execution: All substantial computation on CPU via the owner file bridge. No training, prediction, GPU, SSH, Kaggle CLI, credentials, git push, publication or submission.
tier_method: Final census fully reparses every valid/invalid tier SMILES with RDKit 2026.03.3. A sampled-validated fast reconstruction was rejected after its full distinct-formula total disagreed with the frozen reference; final tables do not use those fast counts.
